MikroTik hEX lite (RB750r2) – Compact & Reliable Ethernet Router

Powerful & Affordable Router for Home & Small Office Networks

The MikroTik hEX lite (RB750r2) is a compact yet powerful Ethernet router, designed for home users and small businesses that need a reliable, high-performance networking solution. Featuring a fast 850MHz CPU, 64MB RAM, and 16MB Flash storage, this router ensures smooth data transmission and efficient network management.


With five (5) 10/100 Mbps LAN ports, RouterOS L4, and a durable plastic case, the hEX lite is an energy-efficient and cost-effective router perfect for small-scale wired networking needs.


Key Features 

  • Fast & Efficient Performance – Powered by an 850MHz CPU with 64MB RAM, ensuring stable and smooth network operations.
  • 5 x 10/100 Mbps LAN Ports – Fast Ethernet connectivity for seamless data transfer and device communication.
  • RouterOS L4 License – Supports advanced networking features, including firewall, bandwidth control, and routing protocols.
  • Compact & Energy-Efficient – Lightweight, plastic case design with low power consumption, ideal for home and office environments.
  • Reliable Storage – Equipped with 16MB Flash storage for firmware updates and configurations.
  • Universal Power Support – Includes a 2-pin power adapter for easy installation and operation.
  • Made with Quality & Reliability – Manufactured in China, Lithuania, and Vietnam, ensuring high production standards.
  • 12-Month Warranty – Comes with a one-year limited warranty, providing peace of mind and reliable after-sales support.


Technical Specifications

  • Brand: MikroTik
  • Model: hEX lite (RB750r2)
  • CPU: 850MHz Processor
  • RAM: 64MB
  • Storage: 16MB Flash
  • Ethernet Ports: 5 x 10/100 Mbps LAN ports
  • Operating System: RouterOS L4 License
  • Power Adapter: 2-pin DC power adapter
  • Casing: Plastic
  • Manufacturing Origin: China, Lithuania, Vietnam
  • Warranty: 12-Month Limited Warranty

Ideal Applications

  • Home Networking – Perfect for fast and reliable internet connectivity.
  • Small Business & Office Networks – Ensures stable and secure wired networking.
  • Basic Firewall & Routing – Supports firewall, VPN, and QoS features.
  • Budget-Friendly Network Solution – Offers affordable yet efficient network performance.


Why Choose MikroTik hEX lite (RB750r2)?

  • Compact & Lightweight – Ideal for small spaces and minimalistic setups.
  • Affordable Yet Powerful – Delivers high performance at a budget-friendly price.
  • Reliable & Long-Lasting – 12-month warranty for peace of mind.
  • Easy Setup & Configuration – Perfect for both beginners and advanced users.
